tool_input.description: Check staged and snapshot row counts
tool_input.sql:
SELECT 'stg_fsc_account' as model, count(*) as cnt FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_STAGED.STG_FSC_ACCOUNT
UNION ALL
SELECT 'snap_fsc_account', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SNAPSHOTS.SNAP_FSC_ACCOUNT
UNION ALL
SELECT 'raw_fsc_account', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.BRONZE.RAW_FSC_ACCOUNT
